jobs.title: Business Operations
jobs.description:
About Blacksmith

 - We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

 - Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 7,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 10x so far in 2026.

 - We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 100k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.

 - We’ve raised $58.5M from Seed to Series B, led by Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.

 - Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.

 - We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.

Business Operations thrives in ambiguity and obsesses over ensuring the founders are able to operate as efficiently and effectively as possible. You take a no-ego approach and want to take as much responsibility as possible, freeing up the founders to execute on the highest priority tasks.

This is a front row seat to operating a truly hypergrowth business. We grew 12X in 2025, have already grown over 10X again so far this year and this curve is accelerating. You will get the opportunity to truly impact this next phase of growth.



You are a good fit if you

 - Are sharp, resourceful, and thrive in ambiguity. You can quickly pick things up, make sense of messy or undefined problems, and just figure it out.

 - Care deeply about making the founders more effective. You operate like a force multiplier by anticipating needs, unblocking bottlenecks, and proactively driving leverage.

 - Can own and run core operational processes that keep the company moving, from paying bills to onboarding employees to managing vendors.

 - Are detail-oriented and sweat the small stuff - and you never drop the ball.

 - Love automating anything that can be automated, proactively use AI tools to figure things out, and are highly resourceful when you don’t know the answer yet.

 - Have prior experience in private equity, investment banking, consulting, operations, or other fast-paced environments where ambiguity is the norm.

 - Want to be part of a small team where your work has real impact, and where success in this role can evolve into leading a critical part of the company over time.

 - Enjoy working in person 5 days a week in SF.
   
   

Compensation and benefits

 - Competitive base + equity.

 - Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.

 - 401K match.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Annual offsite.

 - Early-exercise stock options

 - 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US)

jobs.title: Head of Finance
jobs.description:
About Blacksmith

 - We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

 - Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each month, running CI for 3,000+ companies and hit ~$10M in ARR in less than 2 years. We’ve more than tripled revenue since the start of 2026.

 - We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 100k vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.

 - We’ve raised $13.5M across Seed and Series A, led by Google Ventures (GV), and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.

 - Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.

 - We’re now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.
   
   

About the Role

This is not a traditional SaaS finance role.

Yes, you'll own forecasting, planning, reporting, and the core finance function. But you'll also work directly with the founders on some of the company's most important decisions:

 - How should we allocate capital as Blacksmith scales?

 - How much infrastructure should we invest in and when?

 - How do we balance growth, reliability, and capital efficiency?

 - How should we finance infrastructure growth through a combination of equity, cash flow, and debt?

 - How do we think about pricing, margins, and long-term unit economics?

 - When should we raise capital and how much?

You'll help build the financial foundation for a company that sits at the intersection of software and large-scale infrastructure.

As Blacksmith scales, we expect infrastructure investment to become a major use of capital. We're looking for someone who can help us think through not only how much capacity to build, but how that growth should be financed.



What You'll Do

 - Own financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, and board reporting.

 - Build models to support company planning and strategic decision-making.

 - Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to forecast infrastructure investment and capacity requirements.

 - Own cash forecasting, treasury management, capital planning, and financing strategy.

 - Analyze pricing, margins, and business performance.

 - Support fundraising, investor relations, and strategic projects.

 - Build the systems and processes that will scale with the company.
   
   

You Are a Good Fit If You

 - Have 7+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, investment banking, private equity, growth equity, or a high-growth technology company.

 - Are an exceptional financial modeler.

 - Enjoy solving ambiguous, first-principles problems.

 - Can communicate effectively with both engineers and executives.

 - Have strong business judgment and a bias toward action.

 - Want to work closely with founders and help shape company strategy.

 - Understand how high-growth companies finance expansion and think strategically about capital structure.

 - Enjoy working in person 5 days a week in SF.
   
   

Bonus

 - Experience in an infrastructure, cloud, or developer tools company.

 - Experience with consumption-based businesses.

 - Experience with fundraising, capital planning, debt facilities, equipment financing, or infrastructure-intensive businesses.

 - Experience building a finance function from the ground up.



Compensation and benefits

 - Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.

 - Competitive base + equity.

 - 401K match.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Annual offsite.

 - Early-exercise stock options

 - 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US)

jobs.title: General Manager, Sandboxes
jobs.description:
ABOUT BLACKSMITH

 - We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

 - Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 7,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 10x so far in 2026.

 - We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 100k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.

 - We’ve raised $58.5M from Seed to Series B, led by Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.

 - Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.

 - We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.
   


THE ROLE

Blacksmith is building the fastest cloud for code: the infra layer where software gets run, tested, and fixed. As AI makes code generation cheaper, the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to running it quickly, at scale. Every agent workflow needs a fast, isolated place to run.

We are hiring a General Manager to build Blacksmith’s Sandboxes business.

You will own the business end-to-end: product strategy, customer development, go-to-market, pricing, partnerships, adoption, revenue, unit economics, and team-building.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will work directly with Blacksmith’s founders and engineering team to make Blacksmith the default execution platform for AI agents and software work.

The role should feel like building a new infrastructure company, except you will start with Blacksmith’s compute and storage fleet, execution stack, customers, capital, and distribution.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Develop a clear view of the sandbox market, customers, product, and how Blacksmith wins.

 - Work directly with early customers building agents and other code-execution products, turning their needs into the roadmap.

 - Make Blacksmith the default sandbox provider for AI startups, developer companies, and larger enterprises.

 - Build repeatable acquisition, onboarding, retention, and expansion motions.

 - Own pricing, packaging, partnerships, adoption, revenue, and unit economics.

 - Establish Blacksmith as the technical and commercial leader in sandbox infrastructure.

 - Recruit and lead a dedicated cross-functional team.


WHO YOU ARE

You may be a former founder, an early leader at a developer-infrastructure company, or someone who has built a technical product from zero to meaningful adoption.

You are:

 - Technically credible with engineers and technical founders.

 - Strong across both product and go-to-market.

 - Exceptionally ambitious and hungry to build something enormous, not merely launch a successful product.

 - Comfortable personally selling, onboarding customers, and doing unscalable work before a mature motion exists.

 - Highly urgent, hands-on, and effective in ambiguous environments.

 - Able to move between strategy, customer conversations, product decisions, and execution.

 - Excited to own an entire business rather than a single function.

You do not need to be a systems engineer, but you should be fluent in developer platforms, distributed systems, workload isolation, infrastructure economics, APIs, reliability, and security.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF

 - You have primarily managed mature products with established product-market fit.

 - You want to build a large team before personally doing the work.

 - You are more comfortable coordinating functions than directly owning outcomes.

 - You need a well-defined roadmap or organizational structure to make progress.



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

 - Medical, Vision, and Dental insurance.

 - Competitive base + equity.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Annual offsite.

 - Early-exercise stock options

 - 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (US)
